steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: Saintess...

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: The clerics who followed the sinner Adso in betraying the Vine-Bead Court have all pled guilty. They are currently being kept in another one of our estates, awaiting your judgment.

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: How do you intend to... punish them, Great Saintess...?
The great hall is deserted. The seats lie bare, even though they are full most days.
Only a single young cleric sits before her, awaiting her word with bowed head.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I have heard of what happened during the unrest.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: They were led astray by Adso, and did much wrong.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But I believe their hearts were always focused on defending Kjerag.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Them stepping forward to confront the intruders is atonement enough. There is no moral nor logical reason to sentence them to heavy punishment.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Have them go about the lands of the Three Clans. It is their duty to help the people complete this winter's farmwork. They are also to examine themselves, and ask how the scriptures they recite every day can be put into practice.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Once spring comes, they may return to the Court.

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: Yes, Your Holiness...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Is there anything else?

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: Great Saintess... If I may be so bold as to ask you for guidance...

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: During your Pilgrimage, did you hear Kjeragandr's will?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Why do you ask?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Have you forgotten that we should not demand She show Herself?
The cleric lowers his head even further, hesitantly speaking further.

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: The people believe that when the Victorians invaded, She worked another miracle and scared them into retreating.

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: I don't know why, but... I feel like it was more of a... wave goodbye...

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: I think, maybe around the time that Catastrophe happened, Kjeragandr had already left us.

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: If you wish to punish me for my impiety, Saintess... I will also...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Matthew... You are Matthew, correct?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Can you tell me why you decided to join the Court?

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: When I was younger, my parents had five children to feed, and our fields were not up for the task. They decided to send me, the youngest, to the Court.

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: They would save on having to feed one more mouth, and I would be fed by the Court as well...

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: I studied hard, of course! I have been carefully reciting the Kjeragandr these past few years, studying all Her teachings.

spans.text: I studied hard, of course! I have been carefully reciting the
these past few years, studying all Her teachings.

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: But I have seen Kjerag change a lot since then.

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: There are too many things I have never heard of, things that not even the Kjeragandr can explain.

spans.text: There are too many things I have never heard of, things that not even the

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: I had thought that, as long as we had enough to eat and a roof over our heads to keep out the wind and snow, we would live out our days in happiness.

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: But why is it now, when we have those things, that we become even more lost...

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: Saintess, could it be that the people of Kjerag have strayed too far from the road She has shown us?

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: Which led Kjeragandr to... leave us...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: When has Kjeragandr ever shown Her people one specific road to follow?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: When the first peoples came to these mountains, using their picks to split the frozen ground and their axes to hew trees for homes, they could never have imagined...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: That today, the people of this land have fixed their gazes beyond the stars.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But equally, Kjeragandr has never promised us a land of purity, eternally free from disaster.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: We will face ever greater dangers, seeking our way through all kinds of trials.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Until one day, we arrive before Her, and we ask Her our questions about ourselves...

steps.name: Young Cleric
steps.text: But Your Holiness, Kjeragandr is our greatest sage, our teacher, our leader... Does She truly have no commands for Her people?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It is not a command, per se...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: But consider for a moment. The most important wisdom Kjeragandr gave us has already been written in our scripture long ago, has it not?

a.text: Remember the path you walked, and let not yourself forget;
Fear the blizzard that has yet to come, and let not yourself be arrogant;
Clutch your bows and arrows, pickaxes and hoes tight, and let not yourself be careless;
Love your brothers and sisters, love your neighbors and friends, and love the rocks and hills, the grass and trees, as you would love your own siblings.
Heed these words, and no calamity shall prevail over you, and your home and hearth will be safe forever more.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Still busy, Elena?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Director Silence?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I heard you're still handling the observation data from before. Hope I'm not disturbing you.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I'm recalculating my models using the data I got on Mount Karlan.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: If all goes well, we should be able to get the precise location of where that extraterrestrial object fell on Kjerag. It beats running across the mountains looking for it.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: This is a major discovery, and it's all thanks to your courage and determination. You've done well, Elena.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You don't need to praise me for doing my job, Director, it's kinda embarrassing...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Oh, right, heard anything new about Carolin?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: We still haven't managed to find her, but our investigation over the last few days found a lot of definitive proof that she was in Kjerag as a spy.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm sorry, but we have to admit... those accusations against her were true.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I remember the time I worked with her. Her face whenever she talked about the sky... I don't think you can fake that sort of passion.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I don't understand why she would...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: 'Ideals' and 'future' are beautiful words, weightless and romantic, without form or substance.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But the people who are the vectors of those concepts... They are still weighed down by the gravity of reality.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I hope that one day, you'll have the chance to ask her yourself.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Ah, I almost forgot. I read your report.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Core nation academics could never get past the theoretical stage when discussing Feranmuts, since they never found any real proof of them.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Most people write those creatures off as mystical mumbo-jumbo.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But now, you managed to find actual Feranmut biosignatures in Kjerag. These incredibly rare observation data might even lead to a massive breakthrough.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It will be a significant step forward for you to be the one to publish this discovery.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Thanks, Director.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But... I don't really have plans to publish it at the moment.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Oh? Is there something else you're worried about?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I... Oh, forget it!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Leaving aside the fact that this was a complete coincidence and I only stumbled across this stuff with the help of two friends, I haven't discovered anything amazing at all!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Besides, our current understanding of Feranmuts can barely even be considered superficial. I can't imagine publishing this would bring about anything except even more of a headache for Kjerag...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: If a thirst for knowledge is a scientist's greatest friend, then a thirst for quick results is their greatest enemy.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Eagerness for success, eagerness for leaving behind your name in the books, even eagerness for an answer, something to prove you're on the right track.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But I won't rush things this time.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I'm not in a hurry to prove myself to anyone. If I'm wrong, then I'm wrong.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The people of the past made lots of mistakes as they explored Terra. Why do I need to try and be a 'wise woman' who hasn't made any?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I've still got plenty of time. Before I head off, I need to recognize that I don't know a thing about Terra.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: An impressive outlook... I respect your choice.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Oh, shucks, I'm not impressive at all...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Honestly, I just want more time to make sure this survey is the best it can be. This way, I won't make a fool of myself publishing a half-baked paper—

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Oh! The calculations are done... Got it!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: We'll find it at...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Is he still not back yet?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I thought you still had some recuperating to do before you could get out of bed.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: No need to worry about me. You don't know a thing about a warrior's mettle.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: It seems he had his way in the end.
The two of them look around. The vast office feels more spacious than ever, much of its former decor having just been moved out. Their conversation echoes slightly in the empty space.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Hardly the first time.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I was curious to see how he planned to clean up this mess he left behind.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: But it seems the plan was to just dump it all on you.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It sounds like you have your complaints about him as well.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Would you believe me if I said I am fighting on your behalf?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I never actually expected him to return.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It's the same story every time. He always has his ways of getting everyone to do what he wants... Whether they're his enemies, or friends and family.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Never caring what others think, always making his own schemes, giving tasks nobody wants to do to the people around him...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...Then shouldering the hardest part himself.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You're the last one still putting in a good word for him.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: In moments like these, I can only understand Enya and Ensia's urge to slam his head against the ground.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Alright, enough grumbling now.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Moving on then. There's only one set of shoulders the heavy responsibility of handling Karlan Trade can fall on now. Do your best... Chairman Edelweiss.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I wish you the very best in your new position.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I thank you for your kindness.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: But I am currently considering creating a special position for the Black Knight.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Director of Public Relations, perhaps, or maybe a brand ambassador, things like that. Just know that it won't be light work.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Alright. Defeat me, and I'll take the job. Right here, right now.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...I forfeit.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Nothing you can do about it, then.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Take care now, Chairman Gnosis.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Wait, Degenbrecher.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...Are you going to leave?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I know not everything happening right now is as he promised.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: 'Making Kjerag big enough for the both of us'. That's what he said.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: While the stage he set for us is hardly small, what he asks us to do is not as we first intended.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: So if you're feeling weary of all this—

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Time flies. I've been working for him for a while now, now that I think about it.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Enjoying myself? Hardly. Feeling weary? I would not go that far.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: But there was one thing off about your little speech.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: The ones standing in this room are not Enciodes's subordinates or attendants, and are certainly not cubs that need his care.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: We were never waiting for him to create something for us, nor were we expecting something in return from him.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: We each walk our own roads, roads that just happened to go the same way for a while.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: So if there is anything you really can't get done without me, come find me.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Hah...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: But there is one thing I will not compromise on.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: No promotion ceremonies.

steps.name: Friendly, Polite Man
steps.text: So, we finally get the chance to meet.

steps.name: Friendly, Polite Man
steps.text: Mr. Silverash.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I am truly honored to receive you in person. I hope your trip to the Snow Realm has been smooth so far.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Smoother than silk, aside from my secretary banning me from skiing. That one's a mighty shame.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: First of all, I'd like to thank you.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: When I was talking with our scientists, they all gave rave reviews when it came to Karlan Trade providing them a safe working environment in Kjerag.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Whether it's making sure the observation station was supplied during the Catastrophe or protecting the scientists during the unrest, Kjerag has shown the responsibility a modern civilization should have.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Rhine Lab's preliminary work in Kjerag is going smoothly, and you and your team deserve some recognition.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: We were merely doing our jobs.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I hope this will make you believe just how much our cooperation with Columbia means to us.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Kjerag has made our preparations. We will do all we can so that when the next Terra-shaking wave strikes, we can seize the opportunity.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: 'Future'. It's a word that really captivates people.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: From a certain point of view, Columbia and Kjerag are both 'young' nations.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: I believe there are times that youth isn't such a bad thing.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Because it's the young who have the courage and energy to embrace the future one step ahead of the others.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Oh, right, on my way to Kjerag, I heard about a little incident that really surprised me.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: I hear your Kjerag had a little 'friction' with Victoria's Duke of Caster a few days ago.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: So I wanted to ask: do you think Victoria is a credible threat to Kjerag, and to the safety of Rhine Lab?

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Please believe me when I say that Columbia is willing and able to work alongside Kjerag to preserve the international order among the core nations.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: If you're interested—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I thank you for your kindness, Mr. Vice-President.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Victoria is our neighbor, and they have always kept a close watch on Kjerag's development. On this one point, they are the same as Columbia.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Oh, I hope that's not meant to be criticism.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Haha. Since competition and friction are unavoidable, Kjerag has no intention of complicating such matters.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What I hope for more is to be able to have an open and sincere dialog between us.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: This ancient land of Kjerag still has many mysteries that urgently need resolving. We must keep in mind that this is the very reason we are seeking cooperation.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: History and religion, ancient mysteries full of charm...

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: One of the rumors I heard said the Duke called the retreat because she saw Kjerag's protector god, Kjeragandr, work a 'miracle' at a pivotal moment.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: The Duke of Caster is a shrewd politician. A mere miracle would not sway her, I'm afraid.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It is simply that she realized if she wanted to achieve her political goals in Kjerag, she would have to pay a much higher price than she anticipated. This is why she abandoned the idea of making us her foe.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: A brilliant gambit, I must say... But in the eyes of others, this is also a signal.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Within the landscape of the core nations, a new state has risen—and Kjerag stands ready for the next round of competition, which will be crueler than ever.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Do you think this is what you intended?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Rather than saying this is any one person's desire, I would rather say it is the inevitable outcome.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Terra cannot give Kjerag the time we need to develop, and since competition and conflict are unavoidable, showing our neighbors our determination is not necessarily bad.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It will let them know that Kjerag will not give up the chase simply because we have lagged behind a moment, nor will we lose heart in defending our interests because of a lack of military power.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Through competition, advance development. Amidst conflict, seek peace. This is Kjerag's choice.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: You sure are something, Mr. Silverash. You're like a seasoned statesman when it comes to all sorts of things.

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: Might be a bit bold, but would you mind one last question?

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: You've resigned your position as Chairman of Karlan Trade, and you've maintained the legitimacy of the Vine-Bead Court in Kjerag. What would you say your role in the country is?

steps.name: Jackson
steps.text: A determined, proactive reformer, or a powerful warlord, or maybe the true power behind Kjerag, hidden in the shadows?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I am afraid this is not a question I can answer for you, Mr. Vice-President.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: When people in the distant future discuss this period of history, see if they still remember the Silverash name.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I hope they will see the name as one of the countless stones forming the foundation of Kjerag's ascent into the coming era.
The manse is deserted.
All is arranged as it was, yet shines as if new. Standing here once more brings only the sense of a lifetime having passed by.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Master? You've returned.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I have.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Are my sisters not here?

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: *sigh* The young mistresses were unaware you would be returning today. If I had known, I would have asked them to stay. How long has it been since you last had a meal together—

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: No need to trouble yourself. There will always be time later.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I think I shall take a little break today. It has been a long while since my last.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Then I am afraid I shall have to trouble you with another matter. As it so happens, you have just received a telephone call.

steps.name: Chester
steps.text: Is it a telephone? Or one of those 'long-distance information transfer'... One of those new-fangled Columbian toys. Would you be receiving it now?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Connect me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Ah, yes, I thought it might be you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: All is well here, thanks to your aid with the prior matter. It was of highest importance to Kjerag.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: A victory? I don't believe we should call it that.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Our patient set-up and long-term build-up are receiving the outcome they deserve, nothing more.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Save your suspense over victory or defeat for the next time we meet across the board.

steps.name: Kjerag Researcher A
steps.text: Surface temperature, 17.8 degrees, stable.

steps.name: Kjerag Researcher A
steps.text: Radioactivity index, 97.5, stable.

steps.name: Kjerag Researcher B
steps.text: All indices within safe limits. Target is stable. Proceed with sampling.

steps.name: Kjerag Researcher B
steps.text: By Kjeragandr... This really is something that fell from outer space. Didn't think we'd get to see it for ourselves.

steps.name: Kjerag Researcher A
steps.text: By Kjeragandr indeed... Our Kjerag's been changing a little too fast, I feel like.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Hello? Elena, can you hear me?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: How're you doing in there? Hunky-dory?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Ah... I don't... feel too great, honestly. This new model of power armor... Still not too used to it.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Everything's gone dark in here, I think I might have hit a power switch or something by accident... Wait, it's you, Director Muelsyse! You're blocking the camera!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Oopsies sorries!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Look, there's no need to be so nervous, most of the armor's functions are automated. Just imagine you're wearing a nice, thick hazmat suit.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Also, Nasti promised me this model has a hundred-percent reliable emergency eject function. It'll shoot you out to safety the moment it smells trouble.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It'll shoot me out?! What if I go too high or something—

spans.text: me out?! What if I go too high or something—

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: No, this really isn't the time to worry about that.

spans.text: isn't the time to worry about that.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Seriously, relax a little. This is your career's big moment, y'know, you should be enjoying it.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Alrighty then, all ready?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I've gotten this far...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Alright! Let's do this!
Deep within the mountains hides a clearing rarely set foot in by man.
The mysterious object that fell from the heavens lies in the center of the clearing. Surrounding it are countless probes and sensors, like some ancient altar.
Elena slowly moves the power armor forwards.
She can sense countless eyes boring holes into her even through the cockpit. Everyone awaits this historic first contact.
The irregular indigo object is right in front of her. Elena takes a few deep breaths, then slowly stretches out her hands.
The robotic arms make contact with it.
There is no explosion, or flash of light, or unexpected activity. It is like an ordinary handshake.
As gentle as a snowflake falling to the ground.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: We've got the preliminary analysis of the sample, Chief Urbica.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What's it say?!

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: The results are really surprising...

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: We have no idea what seventy percent of its composition is. It's not any sort of material known to man.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: But it seems like its structure has been severely damaged.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: As for the remaining thirty percent, we're sure that...

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: There is fundamentally no difference between its main component and the somatic cells of Terra's Elves.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Did you say... Elves?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But why... would Elves come from outer space...?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: It might be completely unimaginable, but based on what we've seen from the sample, the conclusion is clear.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: If we're sure that this part of it is just like an Elf... then wouldn't the damage to its structure mean that it ran into some sort of danger before it fell...?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: So this is the 'meteorite' you were looking for?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: En—Saintess, what are you doing here?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Shh! Not too loud...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I snuck out of the Court. I could hardly miss the chance to see our guest from beyond the sky up close.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It seems... rather more dangerous than I imagined?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Unknown objects always have a certain amount of danger.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Its fall onto Kjerag, was it pure coincidence, or some sort of unexpected factor? Or to put it in another way, what sort of causal relationship does it have with Kjeragandr's dormancy...?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Right now, we don't even know where to start with our research.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The life of a scientist is bitter work indeed.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Oh? What is this screen for...?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: That's a sonographic imager.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Based on our observations, this unknown object is constantly sending out a type of infrasonic wave.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It's very regular, always repeating across the same frequency band.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: How curious... If it weren't for your explanation, I would have thought it was some kind of writing.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Writing...?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The shape of this frequency closely resembles ancient Kjerag symbols that were used to transmit information.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: It's very simple, with an extremely limited vocabulary. It's mostly carved on rocks or trees, to inform your friends of the prey's location, or the movements of a fierce beast, that sort of information.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Hmm... The similarities are striking, now that I think more about it.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Enya! Can you read this language? Could you translate it?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Only somewhat. If you want to decipher it, I'll have to go back to the Hall of Writings to find Memory and Symbols—

spans.text: Only somewhat. If you want to decipher it, I'll have to go back to the Hall of Writings to find

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I've got it here!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: When I snuck into the Vine-Bead Court, I scanned all the books they let you borrow the whole way through with my terminal, just in case... Aha, here!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I didn't think you would...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I'm begging you, Enya, please!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Alright... I'll give it a try.
Enya takes the terminal from Elena, and with some guidance, she finds the relevant text.
She looks at the diagrams in the ancient tome, writing out her translation in the snow with her finger.
